title: A settled loop ruling must not accept a second answer (markDecisionAnswered has no guard)
description:
Follow-up from LIN-4114 research (comment `3c2769ca-b53b-4c16-8666-62502a457982`, section 2). Predates LIN-4114.

`markDecisionAnswered` (`lib/dispatch-store.js`) pushes a stamp on every call. A stale card (open on a page after the ruling was answered elsewhere) accepts a second answer: a second comment and, for a resume, a second follow-up run. Scan rows already have `firstStampWins`; loop stamps do not. Home gets no repaint poll, so LIN-4114's Waiting cards can go stale until reload.

Done when: answering an already-answered or dismissed loop decision is refused with a clear message (or recorded as a no-op) and starts no run; the card shows that it was answered elsewhere.

Witness: answer the same loop ruling twice (two pages); the second posts no run and does not add a stamp.

comments.body: Closing: folded into LIN-4241 and landed in https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2279 (merge commit 94195271, deployed to harbour.cat). `markDecisionAnswered` is now check-and-stamp on `feedbackVersion`; a second answer or dismiss of a settled ruling returns 409 `ruling-settled`, writes no comment and starts no run. Verified on real MongoDB 8.2.4: 8 concurrent answers give 1 stamp and 7 `alreadySettled`.

issue.title: Waiting on you (A): settled-ruling guard — refuse a second answer or dismiss with 409 ruling-settled
